svg.title: The order the search returns
svg.desc: Three ranked lists of the same nine stored facts, each with a line after the sixth row. First list, the example's question scored by embedding similarity only: Lena and shellfish 0.740, Jonas and coeliac 0.732, the dinner plan 0.725, the budget 0.663, Kreuzberg 0.623, Indian food 0.616, then below the line the peanut allergy 0.612, the replaced fact 'strict vegetarian' 0.589 and the fact that replaced it 0.588. Second list, the same question with keyword scores added: Jonas 0.553, the dinner plan 0.480, Lena 0.392, the budget 0.366, the fact that replaced the old one 0.357, Kreuzberg 0.312, then below the line Indian food 0.308, the peanut allergy 0.306 and the replaced fact 0.295. Third list, the question 'what should I cook tonight?': Indian food 0.607, the budget 0.586, the dinner plan 0.564, Kreuzberg 0.564, Lena 0.550, the replaced fact 0.545, then below the line the fact that replaced it 0.542, Jonas 0.524 and the peanut allergy 0.509, in last place.
